analysis_metadata.scope: Resume optimizer vs hybrid-ai-windows governance infrastructure

journey_narratives.issues: LinkedIn headline misaligned with leadership profile

findings.title: No FTAL Quality Loop on LLM Outputs
findings.description: Every LLM call goes to RTX 5090 and returns raw text. Zero scoring, zero teaching, zero retry-with-feedback. FTAL harness only used as fallback when direct inference fails.
findings.impact: No mechanism to detect and retry mediocre output. User sees whatever came back first.

findings.title: No PersonaForge Integration
findings.description: Resume optimizer has own context enrichment but doesn't use PersonaForge. Missing compiled persona context, confidence-weighted memories.
findings.impact: LLM prompts lack personality consistency, professional voice, accumulated learning.
files_affected: all modules calling call_llm() or call_smart()

findings.title: Data Quality Issues
findings.description: 7 client projects duplicated 2-3x, ~500 journey events with date-only titles, stale LinkedIn headline.
findings.impact: Graph traversal returns duplicate evidence, noise in timeline, misaligned public profile.

findings.title: SQLite Concurrency & Durability
findings.description: Every module does sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) independently. No WAL mode, no connection pooling.
findings.impact: Risk of 'database is locked' errors with concurrent agent background jobs.

findings.title: Sequential Agent Orchestrator
findings.description: Orchestrator chains agents sequentially. Steps 1 (Resume Tailor) and 2 (Cover Letter) are independent.
findings.impact: Pipeline takes 2x longer than necessary for independent steps.

findings.title: requests instead of httpx
findings.description: Gateway migrated to httpx in Phase 24B. Resume optimizer still uses synchronous requests.
findings.impact: Blocks Flask worker threads during 300s inference calls.

findings.title: Security Gaps
findings.description: Raw f-string SQL, no JWT auth, no input validation, CORS wide open.
findings.impact: Not production-safe. SQL injection risk in context_enrichment.py.

findings.title: No Application Feedback Loop
findings.description: application_feedback table exists with 0 rows. No signal from pipeline stages back to agents.
findings.impact: Cannot learn which resume versions and cover letters lead to interviews.

findings.title: Deep Profile Staleness
findings.description: Deep profile built once, never refreshed when source data changes.
findings.impact: Profile drifts from reality as new projects analyzed and experiences extracted.

findings.title: Missing Graph Traceability
findings.description: No edges connecting resume versions to evidence that generated them.
findings.impact: Cannot answer 'why does this bullet exist?' or track which evidence is untapped.

findings.title: Wave 2/3 Agents Never Exercised
findings.description: Cover Letter, Interview Coach, Career Advisor, Orchestrator have zero real usage.
findings.impact: Quality unknown with real career data.

findings.title: LinkedIn Narrative Quality Misaligned
findings.description: Generated headline 'AI/ML Engineer | LLM Specialist' positions as IC. Deep profile identifies practice builder, P&L leader.
findings.impact: Public profile doesn't match actual career trajectory and differentiators.

recommendations.title: Route quality-sensitive calls through FTAL harness
recommendations.description: Replace direct call_llm() with call_llm_harness() for resume tailoring, cover letters, interview questions, career analysis, narrative synthesis, deep profile synthesis. Keep call_direct() for lightweight JSON extraction.

recommendations.title: Add PersonaForge client for recall/remember/feedback
recommendations.description: Add PF client that calls pf_recall before synthesis, pf_remember for successful patterns, FTAL outcome feedback to adjust memory confidence.

recommendations.title: Deduplicate clients, clean bad events, fix narratives
recommendations.description: Deduplicate client_projects by (client_name, analysis_status). Filter journey_events with date-only or session-handoff titles. Regenerate LinkedIn narratives.

recommendations.title: WAL mode + consistent get_db() usage
recommendations.description: Enable WAL mode in models.py. Replace raw sqlite3.connect() with get_db() context manager across all modules.

recommendations.title: Parallelize orchestrator via Artemis
recommendations.description: Fan out Resume Tailor + Cover Letter in parallel, fan in, then sequential Interview Prep.

recommendations.title: Migrate requests to httpx
recommendations.description: Replace synchronous requests with httpx in smart_llm.py and journey_miner.py.

recommendations.title: Security remediation (future phase)
recommendations.description: Parameterized SQL everywhere, JWT auth, input validation middleware. Planned as future phase.

recommendations.title: Wire pipeline stages to feedback loop
recommendations.description: Store which resume version and cover letter were used per application. Correlate ATS score with callback rate.

recommendations.title: Event-driven deep profile refresh
recommendations.description: Mark profile stale on source data changes. Offer incremental rebuild.

recommendations.title: Add version-sourced-from graph edges
recommendations.description: Add ro_version_sourced_from edges connecting resume_versions to client projects, outcomes, milestones.

recommendations.title: End-to-end pipeline test with real data
recommendations.description: Run full orchestrator pipeline against a real job posting. Score output quality.

recommendations.title: Regenerate LinkedIn narratives with deep profile
recommendations.description: Re-run journey_synthesizer with deep profile summary injected as context.
